f3f1e2e9: 
 ;This routine contains several subroutines related to
 ;DGJTUTL utility functions
 ;Probable functionality includes
 ;handling patient transfer logic,
 ;warnings or prompts, displaying lists, and
 ;checking physician rounding status or other flags.
b51c3200: ;Get current patient internal entry number from VAS global
edc0223a: ;Call warning/prompt subroutine
dfca1962: ;Display 'Choose from:' prompt
43d1c954: ;Loop through list of entries in ^UTILITY temp global and display entry numbers/names

8f6b7127: 
 ;Check if Patient Transfer file entry (PTF)
 ;is valid (exists in PATIENT TRANSFER file #45.84)
 ;and not just a regular PATIENT file entry
92da11f7: ;Set OK=1 if PTF is valid, else 0
ce3b6c0d: ;Exit subroutine
7a51839d: ;Check physician rounding/transcription/review status code against entries in CODE ROUNDING STATUS file #393.2 and set X accordingly
bfd3f553: ;If the appointment DT node exists and has a non-blank value, set X to 0 and quit.

0d688365: ;Get the date of the appointment (X1), the current admission ien (DGJTX3), compute 48 hours from now (X), and if the appointment is within 48 hours of now and the appointment date is greater than the current admission date, call ASK to confirm the appointment time, then kill the local variables.
e3959143: ;Quit if no action requested.
d7c310b2: ;Ask if the discharge summary needs to be dictated.
f34d8446: ;Validate response and provide options if invalid.
7e6d96df: ;Set X based on user's response: 1 for Yes, -1 to exit, 0 for No.
6282743c: Module exit
22e3e026: Go to full screen mode, export HF values to an array, and queue refresh
856716ef: Set up variables for display and exit
f4cebe0a: Clear temporary global used to store active admissions
5f26a267: Build a list of active admissions in the temporary global, with admission IFN as the subscript
69d8bd3d: ;Check if the patient has any admissions at the current facility, and if not, display an error message and quit.
bc216961: ;Kill (clear) the variables OK, I, and PTF.
62741279: ;Quit (exit the routine).
6ddaac47: ;Initialize the variables X and Y (used in the routine).
6cf7ad62: ;Extract the second piece (deficiency code) from the DGJT variable.
95db11c8: ;If the deficiency code is present and exists in the VAS(393.3) file, display the name of the deficiency. Otherwise, display 'UNKNOWN DEFICIENCY'.
ec0ae972: Display provider narrative.
cae318f4: Exit.
4c079c1a: Initialize variables.
eeaffaec: Initialize ward variable.
5bcaed9d: Traverse movement history and find the first movement with a ward, excluding certain movement types.
7987d749: Quit if calling function is WARDQ.
f8981e07: Initialize variables to null values.
1c19dce1: Get data from file 393 and the division pointer from file 40.8.
08089577: Get data from the division pointer in file 40.8.
b1a3855d: If the note status is TRANSCRIBED or SIGNED and the division status is active, set DGJX and call SET subroutine, then kill DGJATTD and quit.
071f8fdc: Store the 14th piece of DGJTNOD in DGJTPD.
cdb3d624: Retrieve the value of the 'DT' node for the current entry in file 393 and store it in DGJNDT.
ce063c8f: If the DGJFDIC array is defined, execute the code block and then kill the DGJFDIC array before quitting.

e303df58: Assign a value to DGJX based on a series of conditions. If the 2nd piece of DGJNDT is non-empty, use that value. Otherwise, if the 12th piece of DGJTNOD is non-empty, use that value. Otherwise, use the 9th piece of DGJTNOD. Then call the SET subroutine.
05008876: ;Validate and set DGJFSIG if needed.
4ce558a6: ;If clinician or date/time field is missing, use default values from DGJTNOD to set DGJX and call SET^DGJFSSIG.
bbb31800: ;If the value of DGJX is the same as DGJTPD, quit the routine without performing SET.
6c137962: ;If DGJFREV exists, perform the following block of code and then kill DGJFREV.
47a29155: ;If the 5th or 6th piece of DGJNDT is blank and the 2nd piece is not blank, set DGJX based on the 9th or 10th piece of DGJTNOD, then perform SET and quit.

f454346d: ;If the 5th or 6th piece of DGJNDT is blank and the 2nd piece is also blank, set DGJX based on the 12th, 9th piece of DGJTNOD, or an empty string if both are blank, then perform SET and quit.

5916272f: ;Set DGJX to the date/time of last medication/treatment in the outpatient environment if available, otherwise to the appointment date/time if applicable, otherwise leave it blank.
c701b807: Quit if no input parameters are provided.
6246d620: Store the input value in the 14th piece of the ^VAS(393,DA,0) global node.
5b187a1c: Kill temporary variables used in the routine.
